description: Defines schemas for Note and Tag entities, request validation, response formatting, and search parameters for the NoteEase API.

classes.name: TagBase
classes.description: Schema for Tag base properties, used in creating and returning tags.

classes.name: TagCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new Tag, inherits from TagBase.

classes.name: TagResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning Tag data, includes id and creation timestamp.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Schema for Note base properties, used for creating and updating notes.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new Note, includes optional list of tag IDs.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating a Note, all fields optional.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning Note data, includes identifiers, timestamps, and associated tags.

classes.name: NoteListResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of notes.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: Schema for note search filters and pagination.
